title: ASC 952 — Franchisors
summary: Governs initial franchise fees, continuing royalty fees, and area/master franchise arrangements under ASC 606.
description: ASC 952 addresses initial franchise fee recognition and allocation under ASC 606, the private company practical expedient from ASU 2021-02, continuing royalty fees under the sales-based royalty exception, and area/master franchise arrangements. It is broadly converged with IFRS 15 on franchise revenue recognition.

bannerNotice.title: Converged with IFRS 15
bannerNotice.body: ASC 952's franchise fee and royalty recognition is broadly converged with IFRS 15, ensuring consistent revenue treatment for franchising activities globally.
